title: Flowing Ribbons Chiffon Cap Sleeve Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
Gracefully glide through the special day in this chiffon masterpiece! Featuring elegant cap sleeves and flowing ribbon accents, this dress offers a timeless silhouette perfect for celebrating love and cherished moments with sophistication and charm.


Size Tips: The elastic waistband at the back stretches by at least 2 inches.
Prioritize the chest measurement when selecting the size.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
